content.text: The verifier's narrative confirms every substantive element of the finding and identifies no defect to fix — the sole "failed" item is a deterministic carve-out/duration regex that cannot match because there is no non-solicit covenant in the document. There is no substantive repair available; I'll resubmit the finding unchanged in substance.

input.quote: This Agreement shall not be deemed to create a partnership or joint venture and neither Party is the other's agent, partner, employee or representative.
input.rationale: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-inducement covenant exists anywhere in the agreement: targeted searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce", and "personnel" return nothing on point, and the only personnel-related provisions impose no hiring restraint (§ 5.4 (p0035) merely requires each Party to appoint a General Manager as liaison; § 10.2 (p0061) disclaims any employment/agency relationship). The restrictive covenants that do exist (§ 6 Exclusivity) concern competing web projects rather than employees, and § 6.3's two-year restraint binds HDI, not us, so it is outside this employee-focused rule's scope and benefits our party. Because the rule's preferred position is the absence of any non-solicit binding the Customer, that absence resolves to compliant rather than missing. The deterministic duration (=12 months) and general-solicitation carve-out checks are inapplicable: with no covenant in the document there is no duration or carve-out to detect, so those misses are absence artifacts, not defects. Accordingly no redline and no counterparty comment are proposed, and the document text is unchanged.
